name: Black Skull Shield cuts Shieldgore's Rage cost and raises its damage (#1109, #12946)
contract: #12946 and #1109: Black Skull Shield 804354 reads 'Reduces the Rage cost of Shieldgore by $/10;s2 and
increases its damage by $s1%'. The installed Spell.dbc effect 1 is aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER),
MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints -51 with DieSides 1, so -50, with classmask (0,256,0) matching
Shieldgore's family flags. Rage is stored in tenths, so -50 is the tooltip's 5 Rage ($/10;s2). The contract
in AscensionXorothContracts.cpp had set -5 (0.5 Rage), which players saw as a 1 Rage drop (#12946: 25 to
24). Shieldgore's cast spell is 804353 (the 301302 talent node only swaps Infernal Strike for it) and
spell_power_cost reads the raw tenths, so the cost must drop by exactly 50; the old -5 fails that assertion.
Effect 0 is aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), 25%, same classmask;
Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone applies SPELLMOD_DAMAGE regardless of which effect index carries the damage
effect (Shieldgore's is effect 1). At level 60 the owned Sever rank is 501505

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Shieldgore has a nonzero unmodified Rage cost
Force the Black Skull Shield passive aura
SETUP: the Black Skull Shield passive is active
CONTRACT: Shieldgore's Rage cost drops by 5 Rage (50 tenths)
CONTRACT: Shieldgore's damage bonus rises by 25%
REGRESSION: Sever's damage bonus is untouched
